description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) Why don't we share our possessions in common as the early church did?
.
2.) Solomon's Temple: Please what is the significance of not making the laver one, lampstand one, and the table one, as it was in the first tabernacle of Moses, but instead ten in all.  2 Chronicles 4:6 He also made ten lavers and put five on the right side and five on the left, to wash in them; such things as they offered for the burnt offering they would wash in them, but the Sea was for the priests to wash in. 
.
3.) Hello. I'm writing from Kenya, East Africa. I've recently come across some brethren in the church (theologians especially) who hold the view that the Spirit of Prophecy represents only the messages that reveal or talk about Jesus. And that in the writings of EG White the "Spirit of Prophecy" only represents what she wrote about or to reveal Jesus. And that the private letters were written to individual persons or the health messages or such like writings in her works do not constitute the Spirit of Prophecy. Is this the new Adventist understanding? What does the term 'Spirit of Prophecy' mean as used in the Bible. Looking forward to your response. Be blessed.
.
